Message:
I began singing a requiem
to soothe everyone’s hearts...
L-Let me try one more time...!

As I breathed in to
sing once more,
I suddenly felt the fog thicken.
And then...

“It’s no use.
Your song will
never reach them.”

I heard a familiar voice
whisper in my ear...

“After all, you’re only
masquerading as me.
Such songs will never
touch anyone’s hearts...”

A presence with
my mother’s voice continued
to whisper in my ear...

But, I knew it to be nothing more
than an illusion created
by those cursed creatures.

After all,
my mother’s voice had soul.

A soul more beautiful,
and more noble,
than any other—
the soul of a songstress...!
I hear no such soul in this voice.

But...me only
masquerading as Mother...
is the undeniable truth...
